mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I want to create a digital product with AI but have no idea where to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with one narrowly defined customer problem, not a bundle of AI tools. Create a simple version of the product, test whether the intended audience wants it, and improve it from real feedback before building a large course, template library, or funnel. Context: Run My AI Biz emphasizes moving from an idea to an offer through research, product development, sales materials, and organized launch steps. Key factors: audience urgency, your subject knowledge, product format, delivery method, and the amount of human review required. Practical guidance: Write a one-sentence promise, interview or survey potential buyers, and outline the smallest useful deliverable. Use an opportunity-research workflow or business-idea assistant as a starting point, then verify its assumptions yourself. Run My AI Biz can help you turn a broad idea into a focused, testable plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose one audience and one urgent problem, then create the smallest useful product that addresses it. Validate the idea before investing in a full course or large template collection. Use AI for research and outlining, but check the assumptions and add your own expertise before building.
